Complete handling must cover nonbreak transfers, stacked shield cards, burn, grave replacements, shield-trigger interruption and source/target departure. validationNotes.images: All five complete official print images viewed: Shinobu 25SP2 original/TD1/26EX3 and Balgary 23BD4/ART17. Repeated Blocker text in official HTML is the icon label, not a second ability; every printed clause is implemented.
validationNotes.implementation: Shinobu uses the same ordered Select + g1247SplitDeck + g183Return flags as the existing Alice. No change to that common mechanism remains. The only native change adds a per-task live mana maximum to existing InfinityTop1248 and keeps its revealed evolution public to both seats during base choice. All original card definitions remain unchanged.
validationNotes.resolvedAttempts: The initial focused run exposed a missing new-definition g183Return/to:deckTop flag and test fixture mistakes (wrong Dragon/draw-replacement IDs, a new tapped ramp counted as spent mana, a second Balgary entry consumed another top card, and native deployment choice represented as g34_Put rather than paid-summon evolve). Use actual Bolshack dm01-008 and Amodegoras dmrp19-s10, preserve only original mana in payment assertions and reproduce native effect decisions. A temporary defensive common SplitDeck edit was reverted; the new specification now follows the existing Alice flags. Final 71 tests pass.
